fields.System.Title: Reject oversized files
fields.System.Description:
As an admin, I want oversized files rejected before import, so that imports stay fast.
Managers can also start imports.
fields.Microsoft.VSTS.Common.AcceptanceCriteria:
1. Given a file with more than 5,000 rows, when it is uploaded, then it is rejected.
  2. The rejection message names the row limit.

comments.text: Should duplicates by email be updated instead of skipped?

fields.System.Title: Download the error report
fields.System.Description:
Summary

After an import, the admin can download a CSV of rejected rows with the reason for each.
fields.Microsoft.VSTS.Common.AcceptanceCriteria: The report lists the row number and the reason.
